title: Laravel Declaration manifest
description: The YAML file at `laravel-declaration.manifest` (default `manifest/app.yml`). See README.md#manifest.

routes.description: One entry per Router::addRoute() call. Sharing a path across verbs means separate entries.

requests.description: FormRequest declarations. A route opts in with `metadata: {request: <name>}`.

models.description: Eloquent models. Each entry is the class body of a DeclaredModel subclass, found by static::class.

classString.description: A fully-qualified class name. Write it plain or single-quoted; double quotes make `\` an escape.

reference.description: A PHP reference: an invokable FQCN, `Class@method`, `Class::method` (static) or a namespaced function. There is no array form.

phpFile.description: A `.php` file, required once per process; its return value is used. Relative paths resolve under basePath(); one starting with `/` or `\` is used as-is.

closure.description: A PHP reference, or a `.php` file returning a Closure.

concrete.description: A class-string or another bound abstract (not `Class@method`), `~` for a self-binding, or a `.php` file returning a Closure called as ($app, $parameters).

binding.description: A map is one call per `abstract: concrete` entry; a list is one call per item, each self-binding (a `.php` item binds under its Closure's return types).

bindingIf.description: Like the unconditional form, but skipped when the abstract is already bound (deferred services included). A `.php` list item throws; use the map form.

config.description: The argument to config([...]): every `<file>.<key>` path is a config() key. A key may be a dot-path; a map value replaces that node whole. Declare literals, not env(...) expressions.

additionalProperties.description: A config file key (e.g. `app` is ./config/app.php). A scalar here throws LogicException.

app.description: Illuminate\Foundation\Application methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s). Applied in a fixed order, not document order. An unknown key throws LogicException.

bindIf.description: -> bindIf(); skipped when bound, deferred services included

instance.description: -> instance($abstract, $instance). A class- or interface-string is make()d eagerly, a `.php` file binds its return value (any type), anything else binds as YAML decoded it.

extend.description: -> extend($abstract, Closure); parameters `$instance` and `$app` match by name

registered.description: -> registered(); fires right after the block, receives $app

terminating.description: -> terminating(); after the response, injected by type-hint only

router.description: Illuminate\Routing\Router methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s). Applied first in boot(), before `providers` and `routes`. An unknown key throws LogicException.

pattern.description: -> pattern($key, $pattern), one call per entry: a global `where`, merged into every route created afterwards (URI and domain parameters). A route's own `where` wins. Single-quote the regex: `[` starts a YAML list.

model.description: -> model($key, $class), one call per entry: {key} resolves through $class::resolveRouteBinding($value) in SubstituteBindings (`web`/`api` groups), on every route. 404 when null; a route's `missing` handles it. Ignores {key:field} and scopeBindings.

bind.description: -> bind($key, $binder), one call per entry: `Class` (method `bind`) or `Class@method`, make()d and called ($value, $route) in SubstituteBindings. Not an invokable, not `Class::method`.

view.description: Illuminate\View\Factory methods: every key is a method name, its value the argument(s). Applied when Laravel first resolves `view` (callAfterResolving, queued in boot()). An unknown key throws LogicException.

addLocation.description: -> addLocation($location), one call per item: searched after config('view.paths'). A relative path resolves under basePath().

prependLocation.description: -> prependLocation($location), one call per item: searched before every other location. A relative path resolves under basePath().

addNamespace.description: -> addNamespace($namespace, $hints), one call per entry: `namespace::view` searches these paths after the hints already registered.

prependNamespace.description: -> prependNamespace($namespace, $hints), one call per entry: searched before the hints already registered, so it overrides a package's views.

replaceNamespace.description: -> replaceNamespace($namespace, $hints), one call per entry: discards the hints already registered. Laravel replaces `errors` and `mail` itself at render.

addExtension.description: -> addExtension($extension, $engine), one call per entry: `.$extension` files render with $engine (blade, php, file) and are found before every other extension.

share.description: -> share($key) with the whole map: every entry reaches every view as YAML decoded it. View data, creators and composers override it. Never share `__env` or `app`.

composer.description: -> composer($views, $callback), one call per entry, keyed as Factory::composers() is: `Class` (method `compose`) or `Class@method` => a view name, a `*` pattern, or a list. make()d and called ($view) when the view renders.

creator.description: -> creator($views, $callback), one call per entry, shaped as `composer`: default method `create`, called when the view is made, before any composer.

route.description: `path`, `methods` and `action` feed Router::addRoute(); every other key is an Illuminate\Routing\Route method, applied in document order.

methods.description: Exactly one verb, uppercased by the provider. GET implies HEAD. ANY never matches.

action.description: A `Class@method` string, an invokable FQCN, or a [Class, method] array.

prefix.description: -> Route::prefix(); declare before `domain` (prefix() resets domain binding fields)

setDefaults.description: -> Route::setDefaults(). On a ViewController or DeclaredView action: Router::view()'s arguments `view`, `data`, `status`, `headers`. DeclaredView resolves a namespaced `data` value through Container::call().

missing.description: -> Route::missing(); an invokable class, wrapped in a cache-safe Closure

request.description: The `name` of a declared request; the action must type-hint DeclaredRequest, or be DeclaredView.
Every key except the reserved `name` is an Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest method or property. A string value on a method is a reference run through Container::call() with `$request`.

name.description: Reserved: the handle routes reference via `metadata.request`. The last duplicate wins.

rules.description: -> rules(). In a rule list, an entry whose rule name (before the first `:`) contains `\` is a reference; everything else passes to Laravel untouched.

additionalProperties.description: A rule list or a pipe string.

failedValidation.description: Runs, then Laravel throws ValidationException; receives $validator

model.description: Every key except the reserved `class` is an Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model property, assigned before Laravel initializes the model as if written in the class body, or a Model method. An unknown key throws LogicException.

class.description: Reserved: the DeclaredModel subclass, spelled as static::class spells it (no leading `\`).

connection.description: -> $connection (#[Connection]): a database.connections name. Absent: the default connection.

table.description: -> $table (#[Table(name)]). Absent: the snake-case plural of the class basename.

timestamps.description: -> $timestamps (#[WithoutTimestamps]). Absent: true. false also makes other models skip touching this one.

dateFormat.description: -> $dateFormat (#[DateFormat]): how date columns are stored. Absent: the connection grammar's format.

attributes.description: -> $attributes: raw, storable default values of a new model.

casts.description: -> $casts: attribute => cast string (boolean, array, datetime:Y-m-d, encrypted:array, an enum, a cast class, Class:arg). A casts() method in the class is merged over it.

hidden.description: -> $hidden (#[Hidden]): left out of toArray() and toJson().

visible.description: -> $visible (#[Visible]): when non-empty, the only attributes in toArray() and toJson().

appends.description: -> $appends (#[Appends]): accessors added to toArray() and toJson(). The accessor is a method in the class.

with.description: -> $with: relations eager loaded by every query. The relation is a method in the class.

withCount.description: -> $withCount: relation counts ({relation}_count) loaded by every query.

touches.description: -> $touches (#[Touches]): relations whose updated_at is touched when this model saves.

refreshes.description: -> $refreshes (#[Refreshes]): columns re-read from the database after each save.

dispatchesEvents.description: -> $dispatchesEvents: model event => event class, dispatched as new $class($model).

observables.description: -> $observables: custom event names an observer method may handle.

observe.description: -> observe($classes) when the model boots, where Laravel applies #[ObservedBy]: one listener per observer method named after an observable event.

addGlobalScope.description: -> addGlobalScope($scope), one call per item when the model boots, where Laravel applies #[ScopedBy]: an Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Scope class.

getRouteKeyName.description: -> getRouteKeyName() (#[RouteKey]): the column router.model and route() use. Absent: the primary key.
